description: Non-PHI audio fixtures for the G-05 STT/WER pipeline. Public phrases only; no patient, clinician or clinical content.
wer_evidence_note: These files exercise the STT contract and give scripts/stt_wer_live.sh something real to score. A single machine-spoken English pangram is NOT evidence of clinical STT quality (no Hindi/Marathi/Hinglish, no accents, no clinical vocabulary, no human speakers). G-05 closure still needs human-recorded or public-corpus audio with human references.

provenance.generator: macOS `say -v Samantha` (Apple system voice) then `afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16@16000 -c 1`
provenance.licence_note: Generated locally from a public-domain phrase; voice output used for internal test fixtures only, not for redistribution as a speech dataset.
